player_prompt.intro:
Ka ne Ɗanƴo {player_id} a SimpleTak.
A kungiyar, hurumi ka sukaɓe a matsayin '{player_stone}' kuma hurumi ɓenaɓe sukaɓe a matsayin '{opponent_stone}'.

A kai ka, za ka zaɓi sel daya (ta hanyar lambar ta) kuma ka ɓuri hurumi ka a can.
Misali, '[12]' ka ɓuri hurumi ka a sel 12.

Burinka ka shi ne kawo hanyoyi hurumi ka cikin sel ɗin ka suka haɗa biɗɓo biɗɓe a kungiyar (daga sama zuwa ƙasa ko daga hagu zuwa dama).

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Sel mara {cell_num} ba halal. Doƴa zai iya tsakanin 0 da {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Cellal {cell_num} ɗon mari. Suɓo cellal meere.

action.placement: Ɗanƴo {current_player_id} ina ɓuri lamba on ({symbol}) a cikin sel {cell_num}.

outcome.draw: The board is full. It's a draw!
